title: Grateful Dead Live at Tivoli Concert Hall on 1972-04-17
source: flac16/48kHz; Source: sbd > 14" 16 track Master Reel @15ips > DAT (48k)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a high‑energy show with standout performances of Ramble On Rose, El Paso and Railroad Blues, plus solid organ work.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the musical flow, noting a "very good" standard EU72 setlist highlighted by Ramble On Rose, Another Merry Go Round, El Paso, Railroad Blues and a tight Truckin' count‑off. The soundboard source is praised for its clear mix and especially the strong organ presence, making this recording both enjoyable and listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments on a high‑energy performance and a clean soundboard recording; no major flaws mentioned, yielding a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints about dropouts or muddiness; reviewers note clear mix and good organ balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard EU72 set with strong second‑set closer (Railroad Blues) and energetic transitions; overall tight and engaging.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir counts off Truckin' and contributes vocals, noted positively.
band_member_comments.Keys: Good organ work highlighted throughout the show.
